info.title: Versonify
info.description: Plisky Versonify, versioning command line tool.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Parameter help for Versonify. AI/automation: run --get-md-help to write the embedded docs.md file into the current directory.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

options.name: --command
options.description: Command name

options.name: --debug
options.description: Enables debug logging and echoes command-line arguments [default: False]

options.name: --digit-group
options.description: Named digit group to target (e.g., 'prerelease') or * for all; comma-separated for passive mode

options.name: --digits
options.description: Semicolon-separated digit indices or * for all

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Runs in output-only mode; no changes are persisted [default: False]

options.name: --flush
options.description: Forces a flush of trace listeners before exit. Do not use unless diagnosing faults. [default: False]

options.name: --get-md-help
options.description: Writes the embedded docs.md file to the current working directory [default: False]

options.name: --increment
options.description: Performs a version increment before other operations [default: False]

options.name: --min-match
options.description: Semicolon-separated minmatch patterns for file update

options.name: --no-error
options.description: Forces zero exit code on otherwise failing executions [default: False]

options.name: --no-override
options.description: Ignores any saved pending-increment override [default: False]

options.name: --output
options.description: Output mode: env|con|jcon|azdo[:VarName]|file[:FileName]|con-nf

options.name: --pre-release
options.description: Shortcut for pre-release workflows (targets pre-release digit group) [default: False]

options.name: --quick-value
options.description: Quick value parameter used by set/override/behaviour/prefix commands

options.name: --release
options.description: Release name associated with this version; omit the value with passive to output the stored release name

options.name: --root
options.description: Root directory from which to search for versionable files

options.name: --trace
options.description: Trace level: info|verbose|off

options.name: --version-source
options.description: Version store initialisation string

arguments.name: COMMAND
arguments.description:
Command to execute: createversion|override|updatefiles|passive|behaviour|get|set|prefix:
  createversion  Creates a version store at the specified version source (local, UNC, or Nexus path).
  override       Queues a version value or pattern to use on the next increment.
  updatefiles    Increments the version and updates files matching the configured patterns.
  passive        Displays the current version without changing it.
  behaviour      Reads or changes how version digits behave.
  get            Displays selected digit values and related settings.
  set            Sets a digit value or release name.
  prefix         Sets a prefix for selected version digits.
